D5/S3/Quantum/SorkinThirdOrder.sorkin_th.name: D5.S3.Quantum.SorkinThirdOrder.sorkin_third_order_cancellation
D5/S3/Quantum/SorkinThirdOrder.sorkin_th.signature: theorem sorkin_third_order_cancellation (v : α → R) (A B C : Finset α) (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hAC : Disjoint A C) (hBC : Disjoint B C) : amplitudeWeight v (A ∪ B ∪ C) - amplitudeWeight v (A ∪ B) - amplitudeWeight v (A ∪ C) - amplitudeWeight v (B ∪ C) + amplitudeWeight v A + amplitudeWeight v B + amplitudeWeight v C = 0
